groups.saying_opens: كتبت إلى نافع أسأله عن النفل

notes: The text runs into report 4661 after «فكتب إلي أن4661 -»; that part (ابن رافع ... كلهم عن نافع) is a separate report and is not read here.
Two taḥwīl branches end at different names (أيوب; نافع), so no shared tail. Nafi is the one asked (rule 5) and his reply is the saying; the first branch stops at أيوب as written.
The matn is cut at «فكتب إلي أن».
